description: Remove a DNS record from a domain your workspace registered through Last Price. Records the storefront needs cannot be removed. Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain_id.description: The domain id, from list_storefronts or add_storefront_domain.

name: remove_storefront_dns_record
